offers.title: Data Scientist Marketing
offers.description:
At bunq, we’re on a mission to Make Life Easy for our users by creating the most user-centric banking experience out there. Our paid marketing campaigns run on predictions about which new users will turn out to be valuable. This role makes sure those predictions are right.

That’s where you come in. As our Data Scientist, Marketing, you’ll own the machine learning models that predict the value of every newly verified user and feed that value into Google Ads, so our campaigns find more users like them. If the models are off, the spend is off. AI can help you write and debug code, but it can’t build the model or judge whether the output can be trusted. That judgment is yours.

Take Ownership 🚀

You’ll own the predictive models that steer our marketing spend. Here’s how you’ll do it:

  • Build, maintain and expand the predictive models for marketing, from first idea to production, starting with the models that predict each new user’s value in their first 90 days.

  • Hit the model quality targets within 9 months: a Spearman rank correlation of 0.50 or higher and a binary model AUC of 0.75 or higher.

  • Keep the models running in production and monitor data and model health to find where to intervene, using Claude Code to move faster and validating everyth

  • Familiarity with Google Shopping, Meta product feeds, TikTok Shop, or marketplace listing workflows.

offers.description:
Channable powers product feeds and digital advertising for 14,000+ brands and agencies across 3,500+ channels. We're a market leader entering our next phase of North American growth.  We need an AE who knows eCommerce technology, builds real relationships, and wants to own a market, not just a quota.

The opportunity

Our North American business is growing fast. The team is small, the market is massive, and the company has the product maturity and global footprint to back serious ambition. You'll have direct influence on how we go to market, who we target, and how we win.

We sell to eCommerce operators and the agencies that serve them. Our buyers care about product data, feed quality, and operational efficiency. If you've sold into the infrastructure layer of eCommerce (the systems that make products show up correctly, everywhere, at scale), you'll feel at home here.

Your role

Full-cycle Account Executive. You build a pipeline, run your own process with help from solutions engineering and Technical Account Management, and close.

  • Work together with Product Managers and own feature or project implementation from initial design to production delivery
